notes.title: Action Fubuki 2.0 Still Work in progress!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I know I promised version 2.0 to be released on March 8th but I couldn't meet the deadline!

Indeed, I have to change many blueprints (codes) because of the introduction of new skins and new animations.

I've been working without a break for more than two weeks to the point of getting a terrible migraine, but I persevere and I hope to finish the update by the end of March!

Furthermore, I have a game project which I hope to publish the page on Steam before mid-April, it will be a game inspired by Resident Evil with a third-person view and many characters and maps .

I encourage you to wait for the release of this monstrous update.

Sincerely

The DEV

notes.title: Update 1.6.2
notes.content:
This update should be the last one before the Huge update 2.0
That will bring new skins, new animations and new environments.

New button added in the main menu: 
You can now access to the tutorial directly by cliquing on the tutorial button
The new mission button will open the mission map directly.

The FX for impact have been removed to allow a better reading of the action.
The hurricane animation have been stabilized which means that it will run more smoothly.

Light environment improved for challenge map.

With the lack of feedback, there is none. It is not easy for me figure out what players don't like but I use my imagination to get over it.

Have a great game!

[b]Next Update 2.0  [/b]

notes.title: Action Fubuki Update 1.6
notes.content:
Final score UI added for the challenge mode with some animation

Fx added when orbe hits the Fubuki

Camera jutsu clone repositionned

Movement added to main camera.

Escape menu will appear automatically when you fall off the stage

Lights imrpoved on the challenge mode map.

notes.title: Minor Updates 1.5
notes.content:
The game has received some updates.

The special technique that you activated with the button K could sometimes block itself and this would hinder considerably your experience.
The special technique "Goro domain" is now fixed.

The challenge mode had a bug that would cause the challenge to stop when reaching 100 ennemies spawned. Now it is no more the case, the challenge will stop only when you have eliminated all ennemies.

When you finish the challenge, there is no more superposition of UI and the main character, the game will then sent you to the main menu.

More updates will come so stay tunes.

The dev.

notes.title: Action Fubuki is Available today!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867486/38a917de006fb0f994c663a2a4724206ccaa022e.png[/img]

Good morning,

Action Fubuki is available for sale but you can also add it to your wish list or offer it to a friend.

During the last few days, particular attention has been paid to the interface and gameplay.
Regarding the interface, I tried to make it easy to read and understand.
Regarding the gameplay, you should know that this game is easy to handle without a controller. All you need is a keyboard and a mouse.

In the future, I will make the controller available to play depending on the success of the game.

Don't forget to leave a review as it allows me to make any necessary corrections.

Good game to you

The DEV
